findings: Attempt 1 passed forward tests but was rejected because calibrator candidate selection was not group-disjoint or executable end to end.
Attempt 2 added raw-group CV selection and full D_b_prob refit but was retained as incomplete until the audit-key batch rejection was explicit.
The accepted adapter intentionally initializes yolov8n.yaml without downloading pretrained weights; transfer weight routing remains a later training responsibility.
T1 evidence is constrained to independent visible and thermal branch validity and cannot support a fusion-superiority or radiometric-temperature claim.

S1 architecture is frozen to deterministic persistence risk, one-fit HGB, and a one-layer GRU; threshold/policy selection remains outside model tensors and will be implemented in I050 governance/evaluation logic.
